allowed_types.title: Allowed action types
allowed_types.description: percent, fixed, free_shipping, bxgy (buy X get Y), tiered (by quantity or subtotal), gift (gift item).

max_percent.title: Maximum percentage off
max_percent.description: Upper bound of percent, BXGY and tiered percentages (0 < p ≤ this ≤ 100).

max_fixed_amount.title: Maximum fixed amount (minor units, 0 = no cap)
max_fixed_amount.description: Upper bound of fixed and tiered amounts, in minor units of the coupon's currency.

rounding.title: Rounding of percentage discounts
rounding.description: Applied once per discount, in minor units.

max_tiers.title: Maximum tiers of a tiered action
